answer: Proposal: rewards and votes strictly linear in bonded capital — the contract pays r·stake per epoch, with no per-head grant, base payout, or minimum. A farmer splitting one bond into a plume of k keys holds the same capital and collects the same total; a nebula of identities cannot multiply what only coin buys. The rule is auditable: the payout formula is a public signal, so anyone can verify that any stake split leaves totals unchanged. Bonds are locked and slashable in contract. Limits: any per-head perk or sqrt weighting reintroduces split profit; whales are oligarchy, not sybil.
